metadata.article_title: Grant of time for payment of court-fee.

article.title: Grant of time for payment of court-fee.
article.content: Nothing contained in rule 5, rule 7 or rule 15 shall prevent a Court, while rejecting an application under rule 5 or refusing an application under rule 7, from granting time to the applicant to pay the requisite court-fee within such time as may be fixed by the Court or extended by it from time to time; and upon such payment and on payment of the costs referred to in 7*** rule 15 within that time, the suit shall be deemed to have been instituted on the date on which the application for permission to sue as an indigent person was presented.]
article.html:
15AGrant of time for payment of court-fee.

Order 33, Rule 15A

Nothing contained in rule 5, rule 7 or rule 15 shall prevent a Court, while rejecting an application under rule 5 or refusing an application under rule 7, from granting time to the applicant to pay the requisite court-fee within such time as may be fixed by the Court or extended by it from time to time; and upon such payment and on payment of the costs referred to in 7*** rule 15 within that time, the suit shall be deemed to have been instituted on the date on which the application for permission to sue as an indigent person was presented.]

6 Ins. by Act 104 of 1976, s. 81. (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).

7 Omitted by Act 19 of 1988, s. 3 and the Second Schedule.
